title: 江戸子守唄 (Edo Komoriuta — Edo Lullaby)
description: Japan's oldest and most widespread lullaby, originating in Edo (now Tokyo) during the Bunka-Bunsei era (1804–1830). A nursemaid (守り) has gone over the mountains to her home village and will bring back toy gifts — a rattle drum (でんでん太鼓) and a small pipe (笙の笛). Approximately 3,000 regional variants are documented; this is the standard Tokyo version. Anonymous traditional folk song predating all copyright frameworks.
